stance_rationale: Forge correctly reports DPL_v3 economic failure, but the package also overstates verification: PIT routing, HHI/G7, turnover, cost, DSR, Harvey, baseline fairness, lockbox charts, and canonical artifacts are not compliant. A failed SR does not make downstream RF-F checks optional.

critical_concerns.description: Forge code directly reads factor_db parquet files and selects Z_Score, while the package claims load_month_factors() and Z_Score_Aligned. This is a direct contradiction of C15/C13 evidence, not just a documentation caveat.
Liquidity filtering uses a rolling 20d ADV including the current day with no t-1 lag shown, so the 2e8 KRW liquidity gate is not proven PIT-clean.
G7/AX-007 is falsely marked PASS: weights.parquet has HHI mean 0.0584, 217/298 sig_dates at or below 0.06, and 179/298 at or below 0.055. ML sizing exemption is not demonstrated.

Hard constraints fail despite the rejection narrative: MDD is -53.38% versus the <45% hard hurdle, max weight exceeds 0.20+1e-5 on 8 sig_dates, and annual L1 turnover reaches 13.20 versus the 6.0 cap.

Realized NAV cost uses 0.0015 * turnover in run_all.R, while the optimizer/turnover protocol requires 0.0015 * 2 * turnover. Backtest metrics are therefore under-costed relative to the stated 15bps one-way round-trip convention.

Canonical Forge artifacts are missing: weights.csv, alpha_scores.parquet, monthly_returns.parquet, equity_curve.png, annual_returns.png, and oos_zoom_chart.png. weights.parquet exists, but it does not satisfy the role prompt's CSV/chart audit surface.

Harvey 5-spec, DSR, and same-period baseline fairness are deferred because G1 failed. RF-F4/F5/F6 still require same-period baseline, consistent DSR penalty, and all five Newey-West specs; failure at G1 is not a waiver.
Lockbox/OOS visual verification is absent: there is no equity_curve.png with a lockbox marker, no annual_returns.png, and no oos_zoom_chart.png, so RF-F3/RF-F8 cannot pass.

supporting_arguments: Pure-function boundary check appears satisfied: run_all.R computes start/end md5 and stops on mutation.
weights.parquet is a real time-series schedule with 298 sig_dates, 5960 rows, exactly 20 holdings per date, and sum-weight max error about 1.27e-7.
covariance.parquet in stage_artifacts/WT_D20260519_001 is PSD with min eigenvalue 0.001875 and condition ratio 84.7375, satisfying the post-shrink risk handoff target.
lookahead_scan_log reports all 13 walk-forward windows PASS for train/val/test ordering.
unresolved_disputes: Whether a failed G1 SR gate permits skipping RF-F4/F5/F6 measurements.
Whether weights.parquet can substitute for the required weights.csv schedule.
Whether direct factor_db parquet loading can be accepted despite PIT-C15 requiring load_month_factors().
Whether G7 can be called PASS when most realized HHI values are near equal-weight collapse.
Whether the under-costed NAV metrics should be recomputed before any final Forge conclusion.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that G1 failure makes incomplete or contradictory verification acceptable; it does not, because AX-002 requires the harness evidence itself to be PIT-clean, fully costed, and honestly gate-complete.
rebuttal_required: Rebuild Forge features through load_month_factors() and Z_Score_Aligned, with lineage logs.
Emit weights.csv, alpha_scores.parquet, monthly_returns.parquet, equity_curve.png, annual_returns.png, and oos_zoom_chart.png.
Recompute NAV using 0.0015 * 2 * turnover and report turnover annual by year/window.
Correct G7 using realized HHI distribution and AX-007 pass/fail rules.
Run same-period baseline, 5-spec Harvey regressions, and DSR with the pre-registered trial count and baseline penalty.
Provide lockbox-visible equity curve and OOS zoom chart.

adding 19 features unlikely to close >100% relative gap
Not blocking for current honest analysis since G1 FAIL dominates
no point measuring cor for non-admittable strategy
G2/G_Harvey/G4 deferred due to G1 FAIL precondition

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Forge self-rejection of the hypothesis is not enough for AX-008; the verification record contains false PASS claims and missing RF-F artifacts.
